column3: A closed tab records its neighbours at close time, nearest first (following ones that stayed open, preceding ones including tabs closed with it); undo reinserts it before the first following one still open, else after the first preceding one, else at the end. Undo focuses the reopened tab
column4: XIN-23: reinserting at old indexes scrambled the order when undone out of order. A list rather than one neighbour id handles a neighbour that is itself closed, and keeps tabs closed together in order
column5: src/lib/tab-order.test.ts; Chromium: close A, close B, undo A then B gives [A,B,C,D] with focus on each reopened tab
